svg.title: Square mats interlocking with trapezoidal teeth

cc:Work.dc:title: Square mats interlocking with trapezoidal teeth

tspan.tspan: Borders; there are four kinds of borders to use,
depening on what edge
you are connecting. The
border types are left, top, right, and bottom;
Because the mats have to interlock, the edges
can't be uniform, so
different edges have
different formats
How to use: these mats interlock with
trapezoidal-shaped teeth (thus
the name "trap"
mats.) They are aligned such that the mats
provide
complete coverage with no gaps. The
side borders are used to make
the teeth
disappear. If you want to make the teeth non-
obvious, change
the border color on the mat
and borders to the same color as the mat.
